<solution task="t0-count">
weltuxle line := lono();
weltuxle n := leidush(line);
keit (weltuxle i := 1; i <= n; i := i + 1) {
    leshdei i;
}
</solution>

<solution task="t0-day-names">
weltuxle line := lono();
krenul (line <> leitchux) {
    weltuxle n := leidush(line);
    nei (n == 1) {
        leshdei "Monday";
    } wogeish nei (n == 2) {
        leshdei "Tuesday";
    } wogeish nei (n == 3) {
        leshdei "Wednesday";
    } wogeish nei (n == 4) {
        leshdei "Thursday";
    } wogeish nei (n == 5) {
        leshdei "Friday";
    } wogeish nei (n == 6) {
        leshdei "Saturday";
    } wogeish nei (n == 7) {
        leshdei "Sunday";
    } wogeish {
        leshdei "invalid";
    }
    line := lono();
}
</solution>

<solution task="t0-even-odd">
weltuxle even := 0;
weltuxle odd := 0;
weltuxle line := lono();
krenul (line <> leitchux) {
    weltuxle n := leidush(line);
    nei (n yeil 2 == 0) {
        even := even + 1;
    } wogeish {
        odd := odd + 1;
    }
    line := lono();
}
leshdei "even " + even;
leshdei "odd " + odd;
</solution>

<solution task="t0-factorial">
weltuxle line := lono();
weltuxle n := leidush(line);
weltuxle result := 1;
keit (weltuxle i := 1; i <= n; i := i + 1) {
    result := result * i;
}
leshdei result;
</solution>

<solution task="t0-fizzbuzz">
weltuxle line := lono();
weltuxle n := leidush(line);
keit (weltuxle i := 1; i <= n; i := i + 1) {
    nei (i yeil 3 == 0) {
        nei (i yeil 5 == 0) {
            leshdei "FizzBuzz";
        } wogeish {
            leshdei "Fizz";
        }
    } wogeish nei (i yeil 5 == 0) {
        leshdei "Buzz";
    } wogeish {
        leshdei i;
    }
}
</solution>

<solution task="t0-reverse-lines">
weltuxle lines := [];
weltuxle line := lono();
krenul (line <> leitchux) {
    koshkil(lines, line);
    line := lono();
}
weltuxle count := dushzosh(lines);
keit (weltuxle i := count - 1; i >= 0; i := i - 1) {
    leshdei lines[i];
}
</solution>
